thesis: The page is a slab spec sheet: every section adds a measurable line (thickness, steel spacing, base depth, finish, pad size), and the signature is the sticky spec rail that fills as the visitor chooses, then opens full-screen as the quote form.

signature.name: Spec Rail + Dimension Callout
signature.summary: A sticky right rail (bottom sheet on phones) titled 'Your slab' accumulates choices from tools and dimension-line callouts; each section ends with a .dim-line primitive (arrowheads + value) that can be added to the spec. The rail expands into the quote form. Reused in hero, core-sample story, tools, reviews and footer.

motion.intro: Giant condensed numerals rise translateY(100%→0) 700ms ease-out; dawn photo slides inside; mask opens via clip-path inset 900ms. Sr-only copy always readable. Reduced motion: static stacked numeral above photo.
stories: Pinned core-sample panel (≥640px): five layers descend on scroll, each dimension callout draws scaleX(0→1) 400ms and matching spec-rail line highlights. Height calc(5*55svh+100svh). Reduced motion: static cross-section diagram.
Spec rail running total counts up cu yd / sq ft via IntersectionObserver; tabular-nums in DM Mono. Reduced motion: final value shown immediately.
motion.hover: Hairline underline grows scaleX(0→1) from left, 200ms var(--ease-out). One language for links, cards and dim-lines. @media (hover:hover) only.
